proposed_rules.trigger: A [2x1] 'The best no-code platform for...' CTA heading + link row appears as a separate top-level row (rc2) below the main content wrapper on every page captured so far.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a site-wide footer fragment/CTA, not per-page default-content or block, so it's authored once and reused.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical text and position recur across unrelated pages (integrations, FAQ, dashboard). Alternatives considered: per-page default-content block (rejected - duplicates content across every page) or a dedicated 'footer-cta' block per page (rejected - adds redundant authoring for global chrome).
